heading.zh: 来源章节：Plastic spacers and bar supports

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Plastic spacers and bar supports” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. Spraying-machine pages are a different catalogue and are not treated here as trailer pumps that forgot a pipe cell. No wall thickness is printed on the spare pipe, and none of these eighteen pages supplies an inner diameter to copy. Piston outer diameter, seal kit and service life are also absent from these pump sheets. A shared model code is not a pipe size: Electric 80 shares HBT80-1816-110 with HBT80-16, and Diesel 60 shares HBT60-13.132 with LZ-60, without copying the pipe cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Name the model. State that its catalogue page has no delivery-pipe diameter. Leave DN and wall thickness blank unless a measured figure is confirmed on the machine. A straight delivery pipe from Xingtai is quoted by pump model, diameter and length, but eighteen published pump pages leave the diameter cell empty. Those pages are: Electric 30 Concrete Pump. Electric Low Pressure 40 Concrete Pump. Electric 40 Concrete Pump. Electric 80 Concrete Pump. Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. Diesel 40 Concrete Pump. The outline does not complete a blank.
